groups.problem: Caching a device before its database write succeeds lets rejected over-limit devices bypass enforcement on retry.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same premature cache insertion and subsequent cache-hit bypass. They report it from different points in the error propagation path.

groups.problem: updateDevice maps every zero-row update to ErrDeviceLimitReached, conflating other update outcomes with reaching the limit.
groups.rationale: Both explicitly report the over-broad sentinel mapping at the same branch. They illustrate it with different zero-row scenarios: unchanged values in MySQL versus rows excluded by the update predicate.
